decision_mechanism.detail: H1 uses raw argmax over start/end logits to select answer span. If the predicted tokens decode to an empty string, the model abstains. The null_score (CLS start + CLS end) / 2 is computed and saved for diagnostic purposes but is NOT used for the answer/abstain decision. No threshold or margin rule is applied.

decision_math.abstain_condition: answer string is empty after decoding
decision_math.note: null_score and null_margin are diagnostic only; not used for decision

validation_decision_analysis.note: Model correctly abstains on 4/8 unanswerable but provides spurious answers on the other 4. It also fails to answer any of the 85 answerable questions correctly (EM=0%), though it does produce partial token overlap (F1=18.7%).

benchmark_decision_analysis.note: Model provides spurious answers to 23/42 unanswerable benchmark examples. It also fails to answer 15/140 answerable questions (produces empty string), constituting false abstentions.

verification.code_reproduces_decision: YES — predict() in run_h1.py matches the documented mechanism
verification.decision_consistent_across_splits: YES — same raw argmax logic for validation, holdout, and benchmark
